targeting.source: Shipped GOB 46 selects a friendly direct object within 10 m, applying Health Regen Rate +40 for 600 seconds.
targeting.runtime: AbilitySupport.Targets rejects hostile flags, dead players and out-of-range or absent views. AbilitySupport.Land applies the actual 46 effect only to the resolved living friendly recipient.
targeting.test: HackerBatchBParityTests.FastHealing46AppliesOnlyToTheSelectedLivingFriendlyPlayerInRange verifies actual +40 at 10.00 m, refusal at 10.01 m, dead, hostile and missing view controls, and no caster modifier. ability-parity-hacker-medical verifies full RPC admission and the actual +100/+140/+100 natural regeneration step.

targeting.source: Shipped GOB 51 is a loaded discipline with while-loaded Max Health and TargetAbilityGrant 1094. It has no active target selector. GOB 1094 selects self.
targeting.runtime: AbilityPassives applies 51 to the loaded character, and AbilityGrantRegistration publishes 1094 to that character. AbilitySupport selects the owner when 1094 is cast, independently of the selected remote view.
targeting.test: HackerBatchBParityTests.GuardianPatcherLoadsARecipientIndependentPassiveAndGrantsOnlyASelfUpgrade verifies the loaded maximum, grant, self effect under other selection and unload. ability-parity-hacker-medical uses a normal 1094 activation with a selected nonmember and verifies the owner receives the resulting modifier.
